name: AD8671 / AD8672 / AD8674
tagline: ADI's 2.8 nV/√Hz, 10 MHz precision part; Head-Fi rollers found it cleaner and more detailed than NJM2068 and AD8620.

lineage.note: Sole source; no second sources known. Later relative: AD8675 (36 V, 2.8 nV/√Hz, rail-to-rail output).

part_numbers.note: Single; SOIC-8 / MSOP-8. Product page live; lifecycle unconfirmed.
Dual; SOIC-8 / MSOP-8; AD8672ARM is legacy leaded. No DIP-8 known (unconfirmed).
Quad; SOIC-14; AD8674ARU is legacy leaded TSSOP-14. Lifecycle unconfirmed.

key_specs.value: Bipolar (reportedly); unity-gain stable, no phase reversal

reputation.summary: Its audio reputation rests mainly on one Head-Fi thread, 'AD8672 - a nice audio opamp?'. One listener found it cleaner than the NJM2068, more detailed than the NJM2068 and AD8620, and harsher than the mellow AD8620 ('not to say piercing'), and less relaxing because of the detail. ADI markets it as a precision part, not an audio part.
typical_uses: Op-amp rolling in DIY headphone amps and DAC outputs
Precision low-noise signal conditioning (ADI's intended use)
caveats: Praise is thin: mostly one subjective Head-Fi thread.
Needs at least ±5 V (10 V total); unsuitable for low-voltage or USB-powered gear.
SOIC/MSOP/TSSOP only, so rolling needs an adapter.
Bipolar input with up to 12 nA bias: keep source impedances low.

counterfeit_notes: No part-specific counterfeit reports. Buy from authorized distributors, as with other popular SMD precision op-amps. Leaded non-Z codes (AD8672ARM, AD8674ARU) are old stock; treat loose market lots with caution.

claims_confirmed: Current ADI data sheet is Rev F (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD8671_8672_8674.pdf).
Revision history includes '3/13—Rev. E to Rev. F' and '4/04—Rev. A to Rev. B' (https://www.rlocman.ru/datasheet/pdf.html?di=35349&p=1).
Rev C→D dated 12/09 (thermal, abs-max, Power Dissipation section); Rev D→E dated 6/10 (https://www.rlocman.ru/datasheet/pdf.html?di=35349&p=1).
2.8 nV/√Hz, 10 MHz, 12 nA max Ib, 75 µV max Vos, 4 V/µs, ±5 V to ±15 V, unity-gain stable, no phase reversal (https://www.radiolocman.com/datasheet/pdf.html?di=35349).
Preliminary Technical Data copies survive on mirrors (https://pdf.dzsc.com/2AR/AD8672ARM.pdf, https://datasheet.sisoog.com/file/7a657573/datasheet/419c81f4f563df7b5c9af6797a1761f8755a265b.pdf).
Head-Fi: cleaner than NJM2068, more detailed than NJM2068 and AD8620, harsher than mellow AD8620, not relaxing (https://www.head-fi.org/threads/ad8672-a-nice-audio-opamp.168976/).
Order codes AD8672ARZ, AD8672ARMZ, AD8672ARMZ-REEL, AD8674ARU appear on a mirror (https://www.omo-ic.com/pdf/361778/ad8674aru-analog-devices/P1-P3.html).
